author: ETA PRIME
description:
This might be the most powerful small form factor workstation we've ever tested. We are taking a look at the all-new MSI EdgeMesa N AI+ powered by the NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X platform. Featuring a custom 20-core ARM CPU, a next-gen NVIDIA Blackwell GPU, and 128GB of unified LPDDR5X memory, this 140W system pushes the absolute limits of Windows 11 on ARM.

Learn More Here: https://www.msi.com/Edge-AI-PC/EdgeMesa-N-AI-plus

We test everything from local AI generation with Hermes Agent and ComfyUI to high-end 1440p gaming benchmarks in Cyberpunk 2077, Crimson Desert, and Forza Horizon 6 using DLSS frame generation. We also dive into the AI Pulse vapor chamber cooling system and show you how to manually allocate unified memory directly to the GPU through the NVIDIA app. Is this the future of mini PCs?
